name: colorcombinations
description: The Dictionary of Color Combinations — historically-grounded color palettes inspired by Sanzo Wada's 1933 Japanese color dictionary.

scripts.build: astro check && astro build && node scripts/make-worker.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run build && CF_PAGES_TOKEN="${CF_PAGES_TOKEN:?CF_PAGES_TOKEN required for a Pages deploy}" CF_BATCH_MB=6 python3 scripts/cf-pages-chunked-deploy.py && npm run indexnow
scripts._deploy_note: Uses the CHUNKED deployer, not `wrangler pages deploy` (2026-08-28). Raw wrangler CANNOT deploy this site: dist is ~174MB across ~3,960 files, and CF Pages closes the upload socket at a hard ~56MB PER CONNECTION. Measured: wrangler died at 2490/3959 with `Failed to upload files`; the chunked deployer (8-file/small-MB batches, a fresh connection each) shipped all 3,961 in 29 batches / 65s. A failed wrangler upload does NOT publish, so this presents as a red deploy, not a broken site — which is why it survived. NOTE the deployer always reports `0 cached` and re-uploads every file; that is a property of the uploader, NOT evidence about the build. (An earlier version of this note blamed non-deterministic image rasterization; that was refuted by deploying a byte-identical dist plus one file and still seeing `0 cached`. The HTML is in fact near-deterministic: a full rebuild changed only 2 of 1,470 page hashes.)
